segments.name: Semiconductor
segments.description: Develops and licenses MST silicon technology and simulation software to foundries, integrated device manufacturers and fabless chipmakers, earning license fees and royalties.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Foundries, integrated device manufacturers and fabless chipmakers pay upfront license fees and royalties on MST-enabled products they sell.
revenueModel.evidence: Under our licensing model, the R&D license fee is due upon installation of MST in a tool at our customer's fab and a larger HVM license fee will be due when our customer completes qualification of MST in their process and before they can sell MST -enabled products to their customers.
